idea-plugin.name: ChangeLog Pro
idea-plugin.description:
Professional Changelog Management & Analytics for IntelliJ IDEA

ChangeLog Pro helps you maintain professional, well-structured changelogs following the Keep a Changelog standard and Semantic Versioning principles.

🚀 Key Features

  • Universal Git Support - Works with GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps, Gitea, Gogs
  • Multi-Step Wizard - Guided changelog entry creation with validation and preview
  • Issue Tracker Integration - JIRA, GitHub Issues, GitLab Issues, YouTrack, Linear, Azure Boards
  • Auto-Detection - Automatically detects your Git provider and suggests settings
  • Keep a Changelog Format - Industry-standard changelog format with six change types
  • Git Integration - Automatic staging of changelog files after creation
  • Fragment-Based Approach - Each change is a separate file, preventing merge conflicts

📊 NEW: Analytics Dashboard (v2.0)

  • Overview Cards - Releases count, commits, average release cycle, current version
  • Release Timeline - Chronological view with filtering (All Time, Last Year, 6/3 Months)
  • Changes Distribution - Visual breakdown by change type with bar charts
  • Git Insights - Commit activity, conventional commits %, documentation coverage
  • Contributors Panel - Leaderboard with GitHub-style activity heatmap (52 weeks)
  • Health Score - Project health rating (0-100) with actionable recommendations
  • Git History Import - Import changelog entries from Git commits
  • HTML Export - Export analytics reports with light/dark theme support

📈 Advanced Analytics

  • Conventional Commits Analysis - Detection of feat, fix, docs, refactor, etc.
  • Breaking Changes Tracking - Highlights breaking changes across releases
  • Bus Factor Calculation - Team risk assessment
  • Release Velocity - Average days between releases
  • Code Coverage Metrics - Documented vs undocumented commits

📝 Change Types Supported

  • Added - New features
  • Changed - Changes in existing functionality
  • Deprecated - Soon-to-be removed features
  • Removed - Now removed features
  • Fixed - Bug fixes
  • Security - Vulnerability fixes

🏁 Getting Started

  1. Open the ChangeLog Pro panel from the right sidebar
  2. Click "Initialize Project" to set up the changelog structure
  3. Use "New Entry" or Quick Add buttons to create changelog entries
  4. View the Analytics tab for project insights and metrics
  5. Use "Import Git" to import commits as changelog entries

💡 Why Keep a Changelog?

A changelog makes it easier for users and contributors to see precisely what notable changes have been made between each release. It's for humans, not machines.
